picks.title: LLM2CLIP: Powerful Language Model Unlocks Richer Cross-Modality Representation
picks.takeaway: 用强大语言模型解锁更丰富的跨模态表示，改进CLIP训练
picks.why: AAAI 2026杰出论文，直接提升多模态检索与理解，开源可复现

picks.title: Fit Pixels, Get Labels: Meta-learned Implicit Networks for Image Segmentation
picks.takeaway: 从图像像素元学习隐式网络，无需类别标签完成医学图像分割
picks.why: MICCAI 2025最佳论文，医学影像少样本分割的强基线

picks.title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
picks.takeaway: 在连续潜在空间扩散建模语言，保留高容量可解码文本表示
picks.why: 突破离散token范式，可能影响下一代语言模型架构

picks.title: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
picks.takeaway: 分层基准评估世界模型的视觉质量和内在反应性
picks.why: 填补视频生成作为世界模型评估的空白，提供可靠诊断
